title: Arreglos: destino no cambia al robar, quitar linea recta, coches embisten
request: Tres fallos reportados por el usuario. (1) EL DESTINO CAMBIA CUANDO EL LADRON ROBA LA CAJA: la causa es que el cerebro del ladron llama a DeliveryService.Fail cuando escapa, y Fail encadena ScheduleNext -> Assign, que sortea OTRO destino. Solucion sin tocar DeliveryService: el nuevo BoxRescueService fuerza el atributo EscapeTime a 1e9 en todos los ladrones (asi nunca 'escapan' ni fallan la entrega, hay que cazarlos para recuperar la caja) y, si la caja desaparece del mundo, la devuelve al jugador manteniendo el MISMO destino. (2) LINEA RECTA SOBRANTE sobre el rastro de flechas: es el Beam del HUD anterior; el nuevo GuideCleanup lo desactiva en el cliente sin reescribir el HUD (no puedo leer su fuente actual). (3) LOS COCHES NO EMBISTEN: CarImpactService v2 sustituye el empujon suave por una embestida real con BodyVelocity (95 studs/s en la direccion del coche + 42 hacia arriba), tumba al jugador 1.6 s con PlatformStand, y ademas escanea tambien los coches que estan dentro de carpetas del Workspace, no solo los hijos directos.

operations.source:
--!nonstrict
--============================================================
-- 📦 BOX RESCUE SERVICE
-- El robo de la caja YA NO cambia el destino de la entrega.
--
-- Causa del fallo: al escapar, el ladron llamaba a
-- DeliveryService.Fail -> ScheduleNext -> Assign, y Assign
-- sortea un destino nuevo.
--
-- Aqui: 1) ningun ladron puede 'escapar' (EscapeTime enorme),
--       2) si la caja desaparece del mundo, se te devuelve
--          conservando el MISMO destino.
--============================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local FORCE_ESCAPE = 1e9 -- el ladron nunca 'escapa': hay que cazarlo
local ATTR_STEP = 2      -- s entre refrescos del atributo
local SCAN_STEP = 0.5    -- s entre comprobaciones de la caja
local GRACE = 2          -- s sin caja antes de devolverla

local server = ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("DeliveryServer", 30)
if not server then
	warn("[BoxRescue] no encuentro DeliveryServer — servicio inactivo")
	return
end

local DeliveryService, PackageEffects
pcall(function()
	DeliveryService = require(server:WaitForChild("DeliveryService"))
	PackageEffects = require(server:WaitForChild("PackageEffects"))
end)
if not (DeliveryService and PackageEffects) then
	warn("[BoxRescue] faltan modulos del juego — servicio inactivo")
	return
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1) Ningun ladron escapa con la caja
------------------------------------------------------------
local function forceNoEscape()
	local rig = workspace:FindFirstChild("Rig")
	if rig then
		rig:SetAttribute("EscapeTime", FORCE_ESCAPE)
	end
	local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("RigThieves")
	if folder then
		for _, m in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
			if m:IsA("Model") then
				m:SetAttribute("EscapeTime", FORCE_ESCAPE)
			end
		end
	end
end

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		pcall(forceNoEscape)
		task.wait(ATTR_STEP)
	end
end)

------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2) ¿Sigue existiendo una caja en el mundo?
--    (cuenta tambien la que lleva encima un ladron)
------------------------------------------------------------
local function boxInWorld()
	for _, inst in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if inst:IsA("BasePart") and inst.Name == "DeliveryPackage" then
			return true
		end
		if inst:IsA("Model") and inst:FindFirstChild("DeliveryPackage") then
			return true
		end
	end
	local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("RigThieves")
	if folder then
		for _, m in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
			if m:GetAttribute("CarryingBox") then
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function rescue(player, session)
	if not PackageEffects.GetPart(player) then
		pcall(function()
			PackageEffects.Attach(player, session.Package)
		end)
	end
	pcall(function()
		PackageEffects.SetPackageVisible(player, true)
	end)
	session.State = "Active"
	player:SetAttribute("DeliveryState", "Active")
	if DeliveryService.Popup then
		local dest = player:GetAttribute("DeliveryDestName") or "tu destino"
		DeliveryService.Popup(player, "Info", "📦 CAJA RECUPERADA", {
			"Un vecino te devolvio la caja robada.",
			"🏠 Sigue hacia: " .. dest,
		})
	end
end

local missingSince = {}

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(SCAN_STEP)
		local sessions = DeliveryService.Sessions
		if sessions then
			local exists = boxInWorld()
			for player, session in pairs(sessions) do
				if session.State == "Dropped" and player.Parent then
					if exists then
						missingSince[player] = nil
					else
						missingSince[player] = missingSince[player] or os.clock()
						if os.clock() - missingSince[player] >= GRACE then
							missingSince[player] = nil
							pcall(rescue, player, session)
						end
					end
				else
					missingSince[player] = nil
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	missingSince[player] = nil
end)

print("[BoxRescue] listo — el destino ya no cambia cuando roban la caja")

--!nonstrict
--============================================================
-- 🧹 GUIDE CLEANUP
-- Quita la LINEA RECTA que el HUD antiguo dibujaba encima del
-- rastro de flechas (es un Beam de GPS). Solo desactiva rayos
-- ajenos a la carpeta DeliveryGuide, y de paso oculta piezas
-- sueltas tipo baliza/linea.
--============================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local STEP = 0.35
local WORDS = { "beam", "gps", "line", "linea", "beacon", "waypoint" }

local function nameLooksLegacy(name)
	local lower = string.lower(name)
	for _, w in ipairs(WORDS) do
		if string.find(lower, w, 1, true) then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function killIn(container)
	for _, inst in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
		if inst:IsA("Beam") then
			inst.Enabled = false
		elseif inst:IsA("Attachment") then
			for _, b in ipairs(inst:GetChildren()) do
				if b:IsA("Beam") then
					b.Enabled = false
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(STEP)
		pcall(function()
			local guide = workspace:FindFirstChild("DeliveryGuide")
			for _, inst in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
				if inst ~= guide then
					if inst:IsA("Beam") then
						inst.Enabled = false
					elseif inst:IsA("BasePart") then
						killIn(inst)
						if nameLooksLegacy(inst.Name) then
							inst.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
						end
					end
				end
			end
			local char = player.Character
			if char then
				killIn(char)
				for _, part in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
					if part:IsA("BasePart") then
						killIn(part)
					end
				end
			end
		end)
	end
end)

--!nonstrict
--============================================================
-- 🚗 CAR IMPACT SERVICE v2 · los coches EMBISTEN de verdad
--
-- Deteccion por PROXIMIDAD + velocidad MEDIDA, asi funciona
-- tambien con coches anclados movidos por CFrame (donde el
-- evento Touched nunca dispara).
--
-- v2: embestida real (te lanza por los aires y te tumba),
--     ademas busca coches dentro de carpetas del Workspace.
--============================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local COOLDOWN = 1.1      -- s entre atropellos al mismo jugador
local MIN_SPEED = 5       -- studs/s minimos para que duela
local LEG_DAMAGE = 25     -- % de dano en piernas
local DROP_CHANCE = 0.6   -- probabilidad de soltar la caja
local FLING_FORWARD = 95  -- studs/s en la direccion del coche
local FLING_UP = 42       -- studs/s hacia arriba
local STUN_TIME = 1.6     -- s tumbado en el suelo
local SCAN_STEP = 0.1     -- s entre comprobaciones
local CACHE_STEP = 2      -- s entre re-escaneos de la lista de coches
local HIT_PAD = 3         -- studs extra sobre el tamano del coche

local server = ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("DeliveryServer", 30)
if not server then
	warn("[CarImpact] no encuentro DeliveryServer — servicio inactivo")
	return
end

local InjuryService, DeliveryService
pcall(function()
	InjuryService = require(server:WaitForChild("InjuryService"))
	DeliveryService = require(server:WaitForChild("DeliveryService"))
end)
if not (InjuryService and DeliveryService) then
	warn("[CarImpact] faltan modulos del juego — servicio inactivo")
	return
end

local lastHit = {}
local lastPos = {}
local carCache = {}
local carCacheAt = 0

------------------------------------------------------------
-- ¿Ese modelo parece un coche?
------------------------------------------------------------
local CAR_WORDS = { "traffic", "car", "coche", "auto", "veh", "taxi", "bus", "truck", "camion" }

local function looksLikeCar(inst)
	if not inst:IsA("Model") then return false end
	if inst:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then return false end
	if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(inst) then return false end
	if CollectionService:HasTag(inst, "TrafficCar") or CollectionService:HasTag(inst, "Vehicle") then
		return true
	end
	if inst:GetAttribute("WaypointA") or inst:GetAttribute("WaypointB") then
		return true
	end
	local lower = string.lower(inst.Name)
	for _, w in ipairs(CAR_WORDS) do
		if string.find(lower, w, 1, true) then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function collectCars()
	if os.clock() - carCacheAt < CACHE_STEP then
		return carCache
	end
	carCacheAt = os.clock()
	carCache = {}
	for _, inst in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if looksLikeCar(inst) then
			table.insert(carCache, inst)
		elseif inst:IsA("Folder") or (inst:IsA("Model") and not inst:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")) then
			for _, sub in ipairs(inst:GetChildren()) do
				if looksLikeCar(sub) then
					table.insert(carCache, sub)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return carCache
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- Efectos del impacto
------------------------------------------------------------
local function sparks(pos)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
	p.Transparency = 1
	p.Anchored = true
	p.CanCollide = false
	p.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)
	p.Parent = workspace
	local pe = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	pe.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
	pe.Rate = 0
	pe.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.6)
	pe.Speed = NumberRange.new(14, 26)
	pe.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
	pe.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 90))
	pe.Parent = p
	pe:Emit(45)
	Debris:AddItem(p, 1.4)
end

local function fling(char, dir)
	local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not (hrp and hum) then return end
	local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
	bv.Velocity = dir * FLING_FORWARD + Vector3.new(0, FLING_UP, 0)
	bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e5, 1e5, 1e5)
	bv.P = 8000
	bv.Parent = hrp
	Debris:AddItem(bv, 0.2)
	hum.PlatformStand = true
	pcall(function()
		hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown)
	end)
	task.delay(STUN_TIME, function()
		if hum.Parent and hum.Health > 0 then
			hum.PlatformStand = false
			pcall(function()
				hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
			end)
		end
	end)
end

local function hit(player, carPos, dir, speed)
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - (lastHit[player.UserId] or -99) < COOLDOWN then return end
	lastHit[player.UserId] = now
	local char = player.Character
	if not char then return end

	fling(char, dir)
	pcall(function()
		InjuryService.Damage(player, "Legs", LEG_DAMAGE)
	end)

	local lines = { "Te embistio un coche a " .. math.floor(speed) .. " studs/s." }
	if player:GetAttribute("DeliveryState") == "Active" and math.random() < DROP_CHANCE then
		pcall(function()
			DeliveryService.DropPackage(player, "car")
		end)
		table.insert(lines, "📦 ¡Soltaste la caja! Recogela antes que un ladron.")
	end
	if DeliveryService.Popup then
		DeliveryService.Popup(player, "Fail", "💥 ¡ATROPELLADO!", lines)
	end
	sparks(carPos)
end

local function tryHit(model, carPos, dir, speed, player)
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then return end
	local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end
	if hum.SeatPart and hum.SeatPart:IsDescendantOf(model) then return end
	if model:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") == player.UserId then return end
	local ext = model:GetExtentsSize()
	local radius = math.max(ext.X, ext.Z) * 0.5 + HIT_PAD
	local flat = (Vector3.new(hrp.Position.X, 0, hrp.Position.Z) - Vector3.new(carPos.X, 0, carPos.Z)).Magnitude
	if flat > radius then return end
	if math.abs(hrp.Position.Y - carPos.Y) > 6 then return end
	hit(player, carPos, dir, speed)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- Bucle de vigilancia
------------------------------------------------------------
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		local dt = task.wait(SCAN_STEP)
		local players = Players:GetPlayers()
		if #players > 0 then
			for _, model in ipairs(collectCars()) do
				local base = model.Parent and (model.PrimaryPart or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart"))
				if base then
					local pos = base.Position
					local prev = lastPos[model]
					lastPos[model] = pos
					if prev and dt > 0 then
						local delta = Vector3.new(pos.X - prev.X, 0, pos.Z - prev.Z)
						local speed = delta.Magnitude / dt
						if speed >= MIN_SPEED then
							local dir = delta.Unit
							for _, player in ipairs(players) do
								tryHit(model, pos, dir, speed, player)
							end
						end
					end
				else
					lastPos[model] = nil
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	lastHit[player.UserId] = nil
end)

print("[CarImpact] v2 listo — los coches embisten y te tumban")
